hero.titleHtml: Chapter Five: Semiconductor Materials and Electronic Devices
hero.lead: From the energy bands that explain electrical conductivity, to N- and P-type semiconductors, the PN diode and the transistor, all the way to electromagnetic broadcasting and radar: in this chapter we discover the physical basis of every modern electronic device.

objectivesLead: After studying this chapter, the student should be able to:
objectives: Know the types of semiconductor materials (P, N) to distinguish between them and state their most important applications, along with their symbols and how to draw them in circuits, and the effect of the junction between P and N materials on the direction of charge motion.
Identify the two types of junction transistor and distinguish between them, and understand the concept of radar and how it works, supported with diagrams.

lessons.description: 5-3: The junction, the depletion region, forward and reverse bias.

lessons.title: The Transistor
lessons.description: 5-4: The bipolar junction transistor, NPN and PNP, its operating mechanism and operating conditions.

lessons.title: Electromagnetic Broadcasting
lessons.description: 5-5: The electromagnetic spectrum, the ground wave and the sky wave.

lessons.title: Radar
lessons.description: 5-6: Defining radar, its components, how it works, its types and applications.
